ui.ask_intro: Ask about any part of your life, a planet, a house, a dosha or a remedy. The answer is worked out from this kundli and points you to the pages of the books (Lal Kitab, Bhrigu Samhita, PVR Narasimha Rao, Nakshatra Jyotish, Tantra Shastra) that discuss it.
ui.ask_placeholder: e.g. When will I get a promotion? / What does Saturn in my 2nd house mean?
ui.ask_key_help: Optional: with an Anthropic API key (console.anthropic.com), Claude writes the answer from your chart and the matching book pages. The key is saved only on this computer (data/ai.json); each question costs a small API fee. Without a key, answers are assembled offline by the engine.
